title: pin-refusal hint says run scripts/release.sh, which dies when the bump is staged but uncommitted
detail: 0.264.0 release: operator bumped prusik/__init__.py + README by hand (staged, not committed). Every hook then refused (installed 0.263.0 behind pin) and the refusal said to run '! scripts/release.sh'. With current==VERSION the script skips the bump step, then dies at 'the last commit touching prusik/__init__.py is not the 0.264.0 bump'. Needed: '! git checkout HEAD -- README.md prusik/__init__.py && scripts/release.sh'. The refusal (or release.sh) should detect an uncommitted bump and say so / handle it.
